title: Ensure 'Print Spooler (Spooler)' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Execute PowerShell command: Set-Service -Name Spooler -StartupType Disabled

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Firewall state' is set to 'On (recommended)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall Properties\Private Profile\Firewall state to 'On'

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Inbound connections' is set to 'Block (default)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall Properties\Private Profile\Inbound connections to 'Block (default)'

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Settings: Display a notification' is set to 'No'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall Properties\Private Profile\Settings Customize\Display a notification to 'No'

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Logging: Log dropped packets' is set to 'Yes'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall Properties\Private Profile\Logging Customize\Log dropped packets to 'Yes'

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Logging: Log successful connections' is set to 'Yes'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall Properties\Private Profile\Logging Customize\Log successful connections to 'Yes'

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Inbound connections' is set to 'Block (default)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security\Windows Defender Firewall Properties\Public Profile\Inbound connections to 'Block (default)'

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Logging: Log dropped packets' is set to 'Yes'
